market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade as AI/tech rally (Nasdaq record) offsets rate fears and iron ore weakness. Bullock hawkishness caps upside. Gold and banks outperform; miners and REITs lag. Oil below $100 supports energy names. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US political developments.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward 'higher rates as new normal' favours financials and gold. China's pivot to robotics reduces commodity demand, pressuring iron ore/coal long-term. Super policy overhaul and housing stress create a multi-year reallocation of capital. AI/data centre capex provides sustained growth tailwind. Fiscal sustainability concerns warrant cautious long-term positioning.
